• AHLWEST (SAST): This financial document reports an inter-se transfer of shares by way of gift within the promoter group of Asian Hotels (West) Limited. Sandeep Gupta received shares from his mother, Vinita Gupta, effectively doubling his individual stake from 8.16% to 16.32% in the company. • ALPHAGEO (Management Change): Alphageo (India) Limited has re-appointed Mr. Dinesh Alla as Chairman and Managing Director for a five-year term, ensuring leadership continuity for a key figure with decades of experience at the helm. A material impact is the significant familial concentration of power, as his wife is Joint Managing Director and son is a Whole-time Director, suggesting a family-dominated management structure. This concentration of related directors, while providing continuity, presents a potential red flag concerning corporate governance, board independence, and potential for conflicts of interest. └ 📄 Source

• ALPHAGEO (Fund Raise): Alphageo (India) Limited (AGIL) announced that Alphageo Offshore Services Private Limited (AOSPL) ceased to be its subsidiary as of September 18, 2026. This significant change occurred because AGIL renounced its entitlement in an AOSPL Rights Issue, diluting its shareholding below 51% and resulting in a loss of control over the offshore entity. The material impact is that AOSPL's financials will no longer be consolidated with AGIL's; this voluntary relinquishment of control raises a red flag regarding AGIL's financial capacity or a strategic shift away from its offshore operations. └ 📄 Source
